# Broiled Test Pork
slug: broiled-test
servings: 3 (2 adults, 1 child)
oven: broiler high
finish: Dinner is on the table.

## Pull these out
### Food
- 1 lb cooked pork
- 1 1/2 tbsp oil
- 1/2 tsp salt
### Gear
- Sheet pan
- Cast iron skillet

## Trackers
### oven: Pork
- broil timed 5 min | Pork broiling | Check in
- check alert | Check the pork | Edges browned and crispy. | Out of oven -> done | +2 min -> broil (2 min)
- done final | Pork out | Broiler off.

## Steps
### Pork: Broiler on (2 min)
Move a rack 6 inches below the broiler and turn the broiler to high.

### Pork: Pork on the pan (3 min)
Spread **1 lb cooked pork** on the sheet pan with **1 tbsp oil** and **1/2 tsp salt**.
Start: oven
Button: Pan is in

### Pork: Heat the skillet (4 min)
Heat **1/2 tbsp oil** in the cast iron over medium.
If alert: Pull the skillet off the heat, then check the pork.

### Pork: Wait for the pork (wait)
Wipe the counter while it finishes.
Wait: oven

## Storage
### Fridge (3 to 4 days)
- Keep the pork with some juices so it doesn't dry out.
